cause: The Notebook planner treated every proposal with an active result head as a rerun, even when the selected time-series Recipe was explicitly dataset-rooted model.genesis.
impact: A valid ETS Recipe could reach a Draft that the materializer correctly rejected because its dataset projection did not permit model.rerun.
lesson: Dataset-rooted RecipeContracts remain model.genesis regardless of a visible active result head; only run-rooted proposals require rerun pins.

evidence.ref: tests/test_notebook_planning_agent.py::test_notebook_agent_admits_recipe_genesis_without_y_or_x_and_rejects_legacy_shape failed for active_head_run_id=run_001 when the dataset ETS proposal was rejected as a rerun child.
